segments.oily: Multiple oily-skin reviewers report the product hydrates without adding shine or greasiness, keeping oil balanced through the day, though it is not universal (one dry-Winter user found it insufficient).
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are split: several find it nourishing and effective for flakiness, while others say it does not absorb, sits on top, or leaves skin tight and dry again within minutes, especially in cold/dry climates.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers generally report balanced results, with reduced oil at the T-zone and no added dryness on cheeks.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly report no irritation and good tolerance, but at least one reports fragrance that burned her skin and another reports a bad breakout, so reactions are not unanimous.
segments.mature: The few mature-skin reviewers describe it as rich enough without being greasy and suitable as a daily moisturizer in a hot climate.

concerns.aging: One mature-skin reviewer reports it is gentle, hydrating, and layers well without greasiness; another describes it as rich enough for mature, hot-climate skin.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe smooth, hydrated, non-tight skin after use, including some with dry/dehydrated skin; a minority say it fails to hydrate enough, particularly in winter or dry climates, requiring reapplication or layering with oil.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports no irritation or redness since incorporating it into her routine; no reviewer reports the product causing new redness.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers generally describe the moisturizer as non-irritating and compatible with actives like azelaic acid and hyaluronic acid, with no reports of barrier damage, though a couple mention burning or reactive skin from fragrance.
concerns.spots: Reports are mixed: several acne-prone reviewers say it caused no new breakouts and even helped clear skin, while multiple others report it triggered cystic acne or painful breakouts within days of use.
concerns.blemishes: Similar split to spots — some blemish-prone users say it kept skin clear and calm, while others explicitly warn it clogged pores and caused breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers frequently report it controls shine and does not add oil, though one reviewer found it left her T-zone shiny and another found it greasy.

extraits.titre: NOT safe for acne prone skin
extraits.texte: If you are even the slightest bit acne prone, do not buy this product. Within a day of using this product for the first time, I developed incredibly painful cystic pimples that still have not fully cleared up even though I stopped using the product after only three days. I love good molecules, but this product is not for me, or any other acne prone individuals.

Not so "lightweight" compared to other dermatologist recommend brands… (cerave, ordinary, etc) it feels more like a thick night cream vs a daily moisturizer, but someone with extremely dry skin might benefit more from this than oily/other types

This is definitely a lightweight moisturizer. It dries nicely and does not leave the skin feeling greasy at all. I have combination skin and get alot of oil build up on my nose and forehead usually but with this, it doesn't get like that! I do moisten my face with water before applying and that helps. Otherwise, due to it being winter, i was seeing some small dry patches here and there. I use the smoothing azelaic acid cleanser with it. And sometimes will use the hyaluronic acid serum with it as well. They dont irritate my skin at all! Im prone to acne and redness and ever since ive started using these products, i haven't experienced any.

I have super reactive dry/combo skin that is clog prone. I use other GM products with good results and my current moisturizer wasn't handling the winter well so I tried this and after a few weeks I'm sold for life. I pray they never change it. My skin is clearing up and looks better than it has in a long time. I add a drop of the squalane oil into the lotion and top it with a drop of the bakuchiol oil and my skin looks great. Flakes are gone and my face looks fuller.

Purchased this product for my friends as a Galentine's Day gift, while also curious as to whether I'd like it or not, so I also got one for myself. I have oily skin, and I've always had issues with facial moisturizers that make my skin more oily. This product keeps the oiliness away all day. My skin feels hydrated. And I love that a little goes a long way! My skin, as well as my friends, are sensitive. However, this product gave me zero irritation.

This Moisturizer is one of my favorite products to use. I have dry, dehydrated skin so skipping moisturizer is not an option for me. It does not have an oily/sticky feeling like some moisturizers and seeps into the skin nicely. I use this in the morning before I do my makeup and there is no peeling which is super important to me. My skin feels nourished, hydrated, and smooth after using this product and that is all I can hope for with my skin type!

This moisturizer is a must for me. I have dry, mature skin and live in a hot, humid climate. The cream is rich enough for my skin, preps for makeup but does not leave a slick or greasy finish. I also love the tube vs jar (more sanitary).
